description.value:
You gain proficiency in Medicine, using your Intelligence modifier instead of Wisdom for checks with it. You can also spend one use of a traumakit during a short rest to aid recovery: if you or any friendly creature within 30 feet regains hit points at the end of that rest by spending Hit Dice, each of them regains an extra 1d6 hit points.

That bonus die grows as you gain levels: to 1d8 at 9th level, 1d10 at 13th level, and 1d12 at 17th level.
